report_top_level_required.pool: top-level pool; drives valid case comparison

metadata_quality_shape.no_metadata_config: metadata.config exists only in metadata mode and is rejected in quality comparison

config_identity_rule: canonical identity is derived only from actual metadata.before facts; config_sha256 and layer_order_sha256 must be known and equal to NativeLight/validated config; architecture class/model type/text model type/dtype are not guessed; dense intermediate is not invented

valid_case.requested: FLAT seven fields; no requested.pool and no requested.batch
valid_case.batch_sha256: original fixture file bytes digest; retained and checked only against an explicit manifest mapping, never against canonical batch digest
valid_case.canonical_batch_sha256: derived from requested using the native_batch canonical JSON digest

invalid_case.rule: validate typed rejection, then exclude from Native gold comparison

comparison.valid_case_order: exact Native valid-case order; invalid cases are excluded only after validation
comparison.word_gate: strict bits_u32 == native f32_bits; values must agree per word
comparison.manifest: optional explicit {fixture_name: file_sha256} mapping for case.batch_sha256

controller.no_rust_phase: separate Root Rust orchestrator owns host execution
controller.mode: docker exec existing container; docker cp into /tmp/qwen35-moe-sdk-root-v1/<runid>
controller.guard: in-container remote_guard; host timeout stops the owned remote Python process group
controller.pins: actual source/binary/provider/module/config/header before and after every Native phase; payload never hashed
